vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm sets out to find A person, maybe 40s, with calloused knuckles. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.

A man, maybe 20s is showing A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.

You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 20s telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about A person, maybe 40s, with calloused knuckles. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
🚶 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm is back — found A person, maybe 40s, with calloused knuckles.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
🛡️ Harper, Siobhan, Yuki, Wei and Naran met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Harper, Siobhan, Yuki, Wei, Naran are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
You STRIKE the Scarred Big-Eyes for 226 (Hunting spear).
The Scarred Big-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Big-Eyes!
📺 You brought down Scarred Big-Eyes. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
